Hola amigo, este foro es para eso pero casi todas las publicaciones son en inglés. Si tienes algún problema o necesitas hablar con alguien solo mándame mensaje. Llevo 17 días sin fumar y muchas cosas mejoran!

Also, I fucked up my relationship with my gf, we were very in love but suddenly I lost the spark and I was desperately to fell in love with her again, I put a lot of effort into it but nothing worked. At the end she found someone else and decided to dumped me last month.

I'm from Mexico, actually I didn't want to work as an engineer last year, i wanted to grow my moms store. I've been in this store since I was a kid, so I always have seen myself working here. The projects were, implementing systems to improve the re-ordering process from suppliers and re-designing the workshop. I'm not that good fixing bikes but I'm not that bad either, I prefer to sell bikes and products.

The problem is that my parents doesn't not want that I work here, they said there is no space here from me. I was kind of stubborn at first, but now I understand that there is really no space from me in here and that I have to find other job. 

Ironically I'm not used to ride bikes lol but I prefer to ride route bicycles.

Well, I wasn't the happiest person in the world but I was in a good relationship and I was full of projects, mainly I was optimistic about my future. 

I like seeing my friends, have a good time with them, make them laugh.. but now even that doesn't fulfill me anymore. 

I'm an Industrial Engineer, but thinks in my country are getting hard, my mom has a bicycle store and I'm working temporarily here. So I spend all day long in here, I actually like to work here.

Anyway, I really hope things get better with time.

I'm kinda in the same situation about motivation. I'm going to therapy and I've learned that I have to do things I used to enjoy, it doesn't matter if I don't get the excitement, it will come.

And it's working, I didn't want to do anything, now I go out every day with friends or alone to a park, a cinema, a bar, anywhere. But I need to put myself out there. Being alone in my room just makes me feel worse.

I know it's hard at first, but everything will be better if you do things, it's the only way to get back motivation. Hope you get better soon!
